**Date written: Sept 14 2023**

## Description

A re-write of script 01: Master Rmd for running the qualitative MSEs. In these QNMs, the **Total Catch** and **Fishery 1 Catch** performance metrics are split by fish size (small / large fish). 

The last part of the script compares the outputs for each performance metric (1) when all fish size classes are together, and (2) when fish are split by small / large ("Total Catch" v. "Total Catch Large", "Total Catch Small")

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

## Functions
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(janitor)

#Load XML first--dependency not included in QPress
#To install QPress: 
  # library(remotes)
  # remotes::install_github("SWotherspoon/QPress")
library(QPress)
library(XML)
library(tcltk2)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)


## custom functions
source(here('R/fxns/parse.constraints.SWotherspoon.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/prepare.dia.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.baseline.impact.table.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.impact.table.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/alternating.list.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.MSEtable.R'))

## let's time things
end.timer <- function(s){round(Sys.time()-s,2)}

## stuff for saving files

plot_out <- TRUE
# d <- format(Sys.Date(),"%Y%m%d")

## model variable key: I use this to order the variables in the output tables.

vkey %<>% bind_rows(

  data.frame(variable=c("offshore biomass inaccessible large","offshore biomass inaccessible small"),
             group=rep("ecosystem",2),
             group_order=rep(1,2),specific_order=rep(6,2))
```

## QNM overview

create a list of lists, so that each operating model scenario (0-5) has its own QNM list.
management strategies A/D use the same underlying QNM structure
but strategies B,C,E require their own unique QNM.
```{r load_models}
s <- Sys.time()


##### 0. A baseline scenario #####
m0list <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00-constantF',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.e <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_00E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)

#### 2. Effort scales according to the Thorson effort model (Thorson et al., 2013) ####
m1list <- list(
  m1 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2-thorsonF',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m1.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]] , # no constraints
  m1.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]] , # no constraints
  m1.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_2E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]] # no constraints
)

#### 3. Climate reduces productivity ####
m2list <- m0list

#### 4. Animals move into the “far offshore” area ####
m3list <- list(
  m3 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004-movement-to-inaccessible',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m3.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m3.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],
  m3.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_004E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]]
)

#### 5. Climate increases growth rate ####
m4list <- list(
  m4 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005-growth-perturb',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m4.b <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005B-rm-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],
  m4.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]],
  m4.d <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Oct_005E-rm-inshore-small-mesh',dia_path=here('data','qnm_models','split_tc'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)


end.timer(s)
```


Add all into a single list
```{r}
mlist_all <- list(m0list,m1list,m2list,m3list,m4list)
names(mlist_all) <- c("OM 0","OM 1 Thorson Effort","OM 2 Fewer Recruits", "OM 3 Offshore Inaccessible", "OM 4 Faster Growth")
```
```{r eval=FALSE}
## check for duplicate edges
for(j in seq(1,length(mlist_all))){
  tmp_mlist <- mlist_all[[j]]
  for(i in seq(1,length(tmp_mlist))){
    tmp <- tmp_mlist[[i]] %>% unite(From,To,col="edge", sep="-") %>%
      group_by(edge) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>%
      filter(n>1)
    if(dim(tmp)[1]>0){   
      print(names(mlist_all)[[j]])   
      print(i)
      print("!! duplicate edges !!")
      print(tmp)
    }
  }
}
```


Some models require perturbations
```{r}
# OM 2:  There is a negative perturbation on “inshore recruits”
PertOM2 <- c(`inshore recruits`=-1)

# OM 3:  There a positive perturbation on “climate pressure"
PertOM3 <- c(`Climate pressure`=1)

# OM 4: There is a positive perturbation on "growth"
PertOM4 <- c(`Growth`=1)
```


Optional: write out models as matrices (for use in other programs, building FCMs)
```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
## all
for(i in seq(1,length(mlist_all))){
  tmp_name <- names(mlist_all)[i]
  tmp_list <- mlist_all[[i]]
  for(j in seq(1:4)){
      m.mat.out <- adjacency.matrix(tmp_list[[j]],labels=TRUE)
      m.mat.df <- as.data.frame(m.mat.out) %>% rownames_to_column("x")
      
      if(j==2){suffix <- "_hcrB"} else if(j==3){
        suffix <- "_hcrC"}else if(j==4){
        suffix <- "_hcrE"}else{suffix <- ""}
      
      m.mat.name <- paste0(str_replace_all(tmp_name, " ", "_"),suffix,'.csv')
      
      write_csv(m.mat.df, file=here('data','qnm_models',m.mat.name))
  }
  print(i)
}


## specific OMs
tmp_list <- m3list
tmp_name <- "OM 3"
for(j in seq(1:4)){
  m.mat.out <- adjacency.matrix(tmp_list[[j]],labels=TRUE)
  m.mat.df <- as.data.frame(m.mat.out) %>% rownames_to_column("x")
  
  if(j==2){suffix <- "_hcrB"} else if(j==3){
    suffix <- "_hcrC"}else if(j==4){
      suffix <- "_hcrE"}else{suffix <- ""}
  
  m.mat.name <- paste0(str_replace_all(tmp_name, " ", "_"),suffix,'.csv')
  
  write_csv(m.mat.df, file=here('data','qnm_models',m.mat.name))
}
```


Save some network complexity info for each QNM. How many variables in each QNM / HCR combo? What is the link density?
```{r}
nvar_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(
  lapply(mlist_all, FUN=function(x){
  out <- lapply(x, FUN=function(y){
    return(length(unique(c(y[,1], y[,2]))))
  })
}), unlist
))

ed_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(
  lapply(mlist_all, FUN=function(x){
  out <- lapply(x, FUN=function(y){
    g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(y)
    return(igraph::edge_density(g))
  })
}), unlist
))
```

Save a data frame of complexity metrics.
```{r}
complexity_df <- nvar_df %>% 
  mutate(MS=c('A','B','C','E')) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(nvar_df))) %>%
  rename(n_variables=value) %>%
  left_join(ed_df %>% 
              mutate(MS=c('A','B','C','E')) %>%
              pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(ed_df))) %>%
              rename(edge_density=value),
            by=c("MS","name")) %>%
  rename(QNM=name) %>%
  mutate(QNM=str_replace(QNM,'QNM.','')) %>%
  mutate(QNM=ifelse(QNM=="O","0.Baseline",QNM))

write_csv(complexity_df, here('data','qnm_models','qnm_complexity_stats_split_tc.csv'))

```


## HCR Overview

These are the HCRs and the associated perturbations to the QNMs:


```{r echo=TRUE}
# HCR A: Status Quo (empty perturbation)
PertA <-  c(`inshore small mesh effort`=0)
 
# HCR B: Remove small mesh fleet, (fishery #1)
PertB <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1,`offshore small mesh effort`=-1)
 
# HCR C: Remove *inshore* small mesh fleet, allow effort redistribution to offshore small mesh fishery
PertC <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
 
# HCR D: Increase the mesh size for the small mesh fleet (fishery #1)
PertD <- c(`inshore mesh size`=1,`offshore mesh size`=1)
 
# HCR E: remove the small mesh fleet from the inshore area
PertE <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

Save into a list
```{r}
Pert.list <- list(PertA,PertB,PertC,PertD,PertE)
names(Pert.list) <- c("A:Status Quo","B:Rmv sm mesh fleet","C:Rmv inshore sm mesh fleet\nEffort redistribution",
                "D:Increase mesh size","E:Rmv inshore sm mesh fleet")
```


## Run each HCR across Operating Models

Each section runs an HCR across all operating models. Then it saves: (1) an RDS for each HCR, with the perturbation output in a list; (2) a vector with the time it took to run the perturbations, and (3) a table of perturbation results for each variable (optionally saving this into a png, if plot_out=TRUE) 
```{r}
set.seed(555)

plot_out <- FALSE
hcr_run_times <- c()

# HCR A -------------------------------------------------------------------
# simulation prep
p_hcr <- PertA   # perturbation
mlist_hcr <- sapply(mlist_all,"[",1)  # we only need the first version of the OM for HCR A
hcr_out <- list()   # empty list for simulation output

# run simulation
for(i in seq(1,length(mlist_hcr))){
  
  # load 'i' operating model
  tmp_om <- mlist_hcr[[i]]
  tmp_om_name <- names(mlist_hcr)[i]
  
  # adjust perturbation if needed
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 2 Fewer Recruits"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM2)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 3 Offshore Inaccessible"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM3)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 4 Faster Growth"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM4)}
  
  
  s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
  
  # run simulation, save to output list
  hcr_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                            edges=tmp_om, # the qnm
                            sampler=community.sampler(tmp_om, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                            validators=list(press.validate(
                              tmp_om, # the qnm
                              perturb = p_hcr, # the perturbation
                              monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
  names(hcr_out)[i] <- tmp_om_name
  
  # save time info
  hcr_run_times[length(hcr_run_times)+1] <- end.timer(s)
  names(hcr_run_times)[length(hcr_run_times)] <- paste('hcrA',tmp_om_name,sep="_")
  
  # reset perturbation
  p_hcr <- PertA
}


# HCR A 
# 15.79955s

if(write){
  # save simulation outputs for future use
  # saveRDS(hcr_out, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-3_splitTC_hcrA_10K_',d,'.rds')))
   saveRDS(hcr_out, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-4_splitTC_hcrA_10K_',d,'.rds')))
}
if(plot_out){
  # save simulation output as an image
  # pert_list <- list(p_hcr,p_hcr,c(p_hcr,PertOM2),c(p_hcr,PertOM3))
  pert_list <- list(p_hcr,p_hcr,c(p_hcr,PertOM2),c(p_hcr,PertOM3),c(p_hcr,PertOM4))
  compare.table <- compare.models.impact.tbl(sim.list=hcr_out, # **named** list of simulations to look at
                                             perturb.list=pert_list,
                                             monitor.list=list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA), # list of variable outcomes monitored (I don't use this)
                                             strong_lower=0.8, weak_lower=0.6,
                                             epsilon=1.0E-5,
                                             plot=TRUE, main.axis="Y",
                                             variable.key=vkey,variable.order="specific_order")
  ## plot (this one should show all perturbations in a single plot, so no need to use plot_grid)
  plot.out <- compare.table[[3]] + ggtitle("HCR A: Status Quo")
  plot.out
  
  png(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-4_splitTC_hcrA_10K_',d,'.png')), res=300,height=1500,width=2800)
    plot.out
    dev.off()}

  # adjust perturbation if needed
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 2 Fewer Recruits"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM2)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 3 Offshore Inaccessible"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM3)}
  if(tmp_om_name=="OM 4 Faster Growth"){p_hcr <- c(p_hcr,PertOM4)}
  
  
  s <- Sys.time()  # start timer
  
  # run simulation, save to output list
  hcr_out[[i]] <- system.simulate(n.sims=10000, # number of randomly generated matrices to keep
                                  edges=tmp_om, # the qnm
                                  sampler=community.sampler(tmp_om, required.groups = c(0)), # thefx to generate the matrices without constraints
                                  validators=list(press.validate(
                                    tmp_om, # the qnm
                                    perturb = p_hcr, # the perturbation
                                    monitor = NA))) # a list of expected outcomes that should happen in the simulation (I don't usually use this)
  names(hcr_out)[i] <- tmp_om_name
  
  # save time info
  hcr_run_times[length(hcr_run_times)+1] <- end.timer(s)
  names(hcr_run_times)[length(hcr_run_times)] <- paste('hcrE',tmp_om_name,sep="_")
  
  # reset perturbation
  p_hcr <- PertE
}

if(write){
  # save simulation outputs for future use
  # saveRDS(hcr_out, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-3_splitTC_hcrE_10K_',d,'.rds')))
  saveRDS(hcr_out, here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-4_splitTC_hcrE_10K_',d,'.rds')))
} 

  if(plot_out){
  # save simulation output as an image
  pert_list <- list(p_hcr,p_hcr,c(p_hcr,PertOM2),c(p_hcr,PertOM3),c(p_hcr,PertOM4))
  compare.table <- compare.models.impact.tbl(sim.list=hcr_out, # **named** list of simulations to look at
                                             perturb.list=pert_list,
                                             monitor.list=list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA), # list of variable outcomes monitored (I don't use this)
                                             strong_lower=0.8, weak_lower=0.6,
                                             epsilon=1.0E-5,
                                             plot=TRUE, main.axis="Y",
                                             variable.key=vkey,variable.order="specific_order")
  ## plot (this one should show all perturbations in a single plot, so no need to use plot_grid)
  plot.out <- compare.table[[3]] + ggtitle("HCR E: Remove Inshore Small Mesh Fishery 1")
  plot.out
  
  png(here('data','qnm_out', paste0('mse0-4_splitTC_hcrE_10K_',d,'.png')), res=300,height=1500,width=2800)
    plot.out
    dev.off()}

```

so, how long did everything take, on average?
```{r}
run_times_df <- as.data.frame(hcr_run_times) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var='name') %>%
  separate(col=name, into=c('hcr','om'), sep="_") %>%
   mutate(om=case_when(om=='OM O' ~ 'OM O Status Quo',
                      om=='OM 3' ~ 'OM 3 Reduced Productivity', .default=om)) %>%
  rename(run_time=hcr_run_times)

mean(run_times_df$run_time)
group_by(run_times_df, hcr) %>% summarise(all_oms=sum(run_time))
```

### set up

Create a data frame to order the variables in the output tables (only including variables that are output for MSE)
```{r}
vkey_sub <- data.frame(variable=c("Total catch Lg","Total catch Sm", "Fishery 1 Lg", "Fishery 1 Sm", "Fishery 2", "spawning biomass"),
                   specific.order=c(1,2,3,4,5,6))
```

These match QNM / HCR codes to text descriptors, for table columns
```{r}
table.key <- read_csv(here('data','mse_table_key_revised.csv'))
```


### QNM 0 Status Quo
```{r}
pert.0 <- list(PertB,PertC,PertD,PertE)
sims.0 <- sapply(hcr_out,"[",1)    # first simulation in every list
sims.0 <- sims.0[2:5]                # remove first sim (HCR A)
names(sims.0) <- c("B","C","D","E")

table.0 <- compare.models.MSEtable(sim.list = sims.0, perturb.list = pert.0,
                        monitor.list = list(NA,NA,NA,NA), no.response=0) %>%
  mutate(QNM=0) %>% rename("HCR"="model") %>%
  left_join(table.key)

table.0 %<>% mutate(variable=ifelse(variable=='Total catch Ls','Total catch Lg',variable)) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(colnames(table.key)),variable, response,change,p_sim, node_to_perturb) %>%
  mutate(p_sim=round(p_sim,0))

write_csv(table.0, here('data','results',paste0('qnm0_hcrB-D_MSEtable_',sim.date,'.csv')))
```

### save summary tables

First, just for the variables tracked in the MSE
```{r}
bind_rows(table.0,table.1,table.2,table.3,table.4) %>%
  filter(variable %in% vkey_sub_sub$variable) %>%
  ## make each variable in the variable key its own column
  dplyr::select(Code,`Operating model`,`Management strategy`,variable,response) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="variable",values_from="response") %>%
  ## reorder to match vkey_sub specific order
  dplyr::select(Code,`Operating model`,`Management strategy`,all_of(vkey_sub$variable)) %>%
  write_csv(here('data','results','split_tc',paste0('qnm0-4_perfmet_splitTC_hcra-e_qualitative_',sim.date,'.csv')))

bind_rows(table.0,table.1,table.2,table.3,table.4) %>% 
  filter(variable %in% vkey_sub$variable) %>%
  ## make each variable in the variable key its own column
  mutate(p_sim=ifelse(change=="neg",p_sim*-1,p_sim)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code,`Operating model`,`Management strategy`,variable,p_sim) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="variable",values_from="p_sim") %>%
  ## reorder to match vkey_sub specific order
  dplyr::select(Code,`Operating model`,`Management strategy`,all_of(vkey_sub$variable)) %>%
  write_csv(here('data','results','split_tc',paste0('qnm0-4_perfmet_splitTC_hcra-e_pSims_',sim.date,'.csv')))
```
